title: Exact sparse checkpoint capture and restore
scope: Two localhost Chromium processes sharing one host. 960x720 picture; every forward frame/effect retained. Dirty replica is diagnostic. Draw CPU wall time is not GPU timing; captured frames are not physical scanout or input-to-photon.

experimentNotes.a1: Full page comparisons/full restore with common timing and dirty subscriptions
experimentNotes.b1: Audited sparse capture and restore, with independent checkpoint/presentation histories
experimentNotes.a2: Return to full comparison/full restore with sparserestore=0
experimentNotes.harness: Same 15–130ms delayed/reordered input workload; separate audited probes fully compare every capture/restore. Journal included in complete-state hash and explicitly compared.
